listener_long_utterance_completion_laten.source: Product-owner direction: 长话结束后的延迟必须进入技术指标，目标是不可以有很多延迟。
listener_long_utterance_completion_laten.scope: Installed C:\Program Files\Listener Type\listener-type.exe 的真实 EmbeddedBle 人声会话；长段定义为 8 至 60 秒自然口述。
listener_long_utterance_completion_laten.requirement: 真实停止按键边沿到最终文本已上屏，或在无焦点时已可靠写入剪贴板，目标并且防回退门禁为 <=500ms。分段必须同时报告：physical-stop-edge 到 Type 停止反馈、停止反馈到 firmware/transport stop、transport stop 到 ASR final、ASR final 到完成/上屏或剪贴板保留。胶囊的 1050ms 成功反馈展示不计入文本可用时间，但必须另行记录，不能用延长胶囊或假进度遮掩慢路径。
listener_long_utterance_completion_laten.failure_attribution: 任何阶段或端到端 500ms 超限都必须留下同一 session 的分段实测值、packet/missing 数据、ASR provider/backend、网络/协议结果和完成状态，并归为 internal_transport、provider_or_network、post_process_or_insert 或 unknown；不得把超限直接写成通过，也不得用固定等待掩盖。
listener_long_utterance_completion_laten.sustained_transport_contract: 长话稳定性是录音能力的独立防回退维度。协议音源固定为 16kHz、16-bit、单声道 PCM，即 32000 B/s；每个 45 至 60 秒真人自然语音机器闭环必须同时证明：连续稳态窗口的有效消费速率 >= 32000 B/s、窗口内生产量与确认交付量的差额不扩大、audio_sent 等于 expected_packet_count、queue_full=0、pool_alloc_failed=0、audio_failed=0、pool_high_water_pct <= 20，并且 mbuf/ENOMEM 通知重试各不超过 audio_sent 的 1%。整段 audio_bytes_per_s 仅作辅助诊断，因为它受实时音源节拍和收尾时间影响，不能替代窗口消费速率。任何队列持续增长、窗口消费速率低于 32000 B/s 或中途 Error 都是 internal_transport 失败，不能由下一次偶然正常的短会话抵消。
listener_long_utterance_completion_laten.trigger_coverage: 该指标是录音能力合同，不是 EC11 特例。所有用户可触发或终止 Listener 录音的入口及其产品适配器，都必须按同一物理操作到最终文本可用的 <=500ms 指标留证；任一入口新增、改动或回退时，必须重跑该入口的真实或等效机器证据。
listener_long_utterance_completion_laten.root_cause_and_repair: 2026-07-17 source/runtime inspection: active device-mic EC11 short press only armed pending_single_click, then waited VOICE_KEY_INPUT_SINGLE_CLICK_DISPATCH_MS=500 before forwarding fallback HID to Type; the matching natural session spent a further 722ms from Type stop feedback to Done. Repair the active-recording first raw edge as a direct Firmware stop/transfer event while retaining the existing 500ms second-click recovery classifier and long-press shutdown path. The same session also attempted streaming polish against an invalid LLM credential after ASR final, then fell back to raw text; bypass that known-unavailable optional branch before it adds latency. Do not delay, fake, or mask the final result.

listener_background_ui_observation_20260.requirement: Listener machine validation must observe installed UI in the background by default. It must not move the pointer, send keyboard input, steal focus, raise, reposition, resize, minimize, or otherwise disturb an operator's desktop. Prefer a process-scoped, loopback-only, ephemeral app-native UI observation bridge such as authenticated WebView2 CDP or an in-process render/state snapshot; collect installed-Type logs and structured UI state alongside any rendered artifact.
listener_background_ui_observation_20260.evidence_rules: A background observation artifact must identify the installed Program Files executable identity, target process/window, capture mechanism, timestamp, and whether it was passive. A blank, black, stale, wrong-process, or state-mismatched image is explicit NO_GO evidence, not a visual pass. Passive machine observation can validate deterministic UI state, button availability, progress, and error attribution, but cannot stand in for a focused human judgment of subjective appearance, perceived smoothness, sound, or physical behavior.
listener_background_ui_observation_20260.interaction_boundary: Foreground activation, pointer or keyboard injection, window positioning, or a visible prompt is allowed only when the product owner has explicitly authorized a current live acceptance/action boundary or when a canonical aiw operator-prompt requires human-timed interaction. Machine-only preflight, package selection, and diagnostics remain background operations whenever the product path permits it.
listener_background_ui_observation_20260.security_boundary: Any UI inspection endpoint is disabled by default, bound to loopback only, opt-in for one bounded validation run, carries no production secrets in artifacts, and is closed when that run ends. It must never become a persistent remote-control surface.
listener_background_ui_observation_20260.current_evaluation: The installed Program Files Type was started hidden for one bounded run with LISTENER_TYPE_WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGS=--remote-debugging-port=9222. Its process-scoped WebView2 target was reachable only at 127.0.0.1, and a read-only DOM snapshot of the main page confirmed ready/complete state, configured ASR, Listener BLE availability, zero dialogs, and control availability. The observer did not move the pointer, send keyboard input, activate/focus/reposition/resize/minimize a window, or read form values. The process was then restarted hidden without the argument; port 9222 was closed. Evidence: Listener-Type\.cache\validation\listener-platform-accepted-behavior-audit-20260716\ota\background-ui-observation\{cdp-targets.json,main-dom-state.json,observation-result.json}. The prior black external frame remains NO_GO diagnostic evidence. This validates passive deterministic state only, not subjective visual quality or continuous observation of an already-running normal process: the present CDP route needs a bounded background restart, so a future app-native restricted state snapshot is required before making it a zero-restart standard.

listener_core_capabilities_platform_cont.source: Product-owner direction: 这些蓝牙的东西, 需要和录音 ota一样, 提取到platform里面才行. 这三个是最容易修到回退和坏掉的. Follow-up: 另外日志也是, 现在platform暂时就这四个东西好了.
functional_capabilities: Bluetooth lifecycle, recovery arbitration, and embedded-audio GATT readiness
Real captured-PCM recording, preview/final attribution, and completion
OTA preflight, transfer, version confirmation, and return-to-ready
listener_core_capabilities_platform_cont.cross_cutting_logging_foundation: Logs are the platform-wide observability foundation, not a sibling of the three functional capabilities. Every Listener feature must emit correlated, structured lifecycle, causal, timing, and failure-attribution records that let Codex trace a user-visible symptom across firmware, installed Type, Windows, and release evidence. This is especially mandatory for embedded debugging; a pile of uncorrelated text logs is not sufficient.
listener_core_capabilities_platform_cont.shared_platform_model: Firmware and Type must implement one versioned core-platform contract, not two independently evolving feature stacks. The shared contract owns capability names, lifecycle states, commands, read/write results, error taxonomy, correlation identifiers, telemetry fields, timing metrics, and regression evidence. The C firmware and Rust Type are conforming hardware/host adapters; future products consume the same platform contract through small product adapters so an accepted platform repair benefits every adapter.
listener_core_capabilities_platform_cont.compatibility_rule: A platform change is versioned and validated across both sides of its interface before an adapter consumes it. No product adapter may reinterpret a core state or suppress a platform error locally. A new product may add adapter-specific UI or hardware transport only after proving conformance to the platform contract and its own user-visible acceptance.
listener_core_capabilities_platform_cont.architecture_requirement: The three functional paths must be expressed as Listener platform capabilities with explicit lifecycle states, ownership boundaries, typed readiness/result contracts, causal telemetry, and focused root-cause regression guards. The cross-cutting log platform supplies correlated firmware, installed-Type, Windows, and machine-evidence records for every Listener capability, not only Bluetooth, recording, or OTA. Listener Type UI and firmware product adapters may invoke the platform contracts, but must not hide protocol state with arbitrary delay, synthetic data, cosmetic UI masking, or unbounded retry.
listener_core_capabilities_platform_cont.regression_requirement: Each capability's release evidence must name the installed executable/firmware identity, active engine or transport, relevant state transitions, measured timings, and internal versus external failure attribution. Any later change on one side of the firmware-Type boundary reruns only the affected capability contract plus every accepted user-visible behavior in its risk surface. The log platform must preserve enough structured correlation to associate every user-visible failure with the responsible platform transition rather than merely collecting text.
listener_core_capabilities_platform_cont.execution_goal: Listener core platform: one versioned cross-Firmware/Type contract for BLE, recording, OTA, and all-capability logging observability.
listener_core_capabilities_platform_cont.current_application: The current Type recovery defect is the first BLE-platform closure: after an explicit Windows re-pair back to this host, the background audio listener must resume only from local Windows pairing/HID evidence. It must never autonomously PairAsync, unpair, or reclaim an external host during cross-host arbitration.
listener_core_capabilities_platform_cont.product_boundary: The active product is Listener. Work may cross Listener Firmware and Listener Type, and may use the owner-authorized Denzic-Platform core only for this Listener contract. A screenshot, command, or request with another or unclear product identity is not permission to modify that product: stop at routing and require an explicit product switch. Similar behavior or a reusable contract never authorizes copying or migrating an unaccepted Listener implementation into another product; each future adapter needs its own owner decision and acceptance evidence.

listener_platform_four_capability_machin.platform_requirement: Each item is a versioned cross-product core with small Listener-specific adapters. The implementation must first preserve each named accepted Listener behavior exactly, then prove a transport/product-independent contract that future BLE, Wi-Fi, USB, or serial adapters can consume without reimplementing core lifecycle, attribution, compatibility, or evidence semantics.
listener_platform_four_capability_machin.machine_acceptance_requirement: Each item requires a reproducible end-to-end machine evidence loop through the real installed/runtime product path wherever the available bench permits. When no human is present, a bounded scripted or simulated operator action may drive the relevant input, but its result must be explicitly labeled MACHINE_OPERATOR_ACCEPTED or NO_GO; it must never be recorded as human acceptance. Missing physical capability is an explicit NO_GO with the missing capability and next concrete evidence path, not a synthetic PASS.
listener_platform_four_capability_machin.final_human_boundary: Do not ask the operator to discover intermediate defects. After all four items have current machine evidence and any detected drift is repaired or owner-deferred, open one final focused human acceptance session for residual subjective product judgment.
listener_platform_four_capability_machin.goal_first_workflow_simplification: Product execution is Goal-first: this detailed active Goal and this registry are the only task/acceptance contracts. Do not duplicate product requirements in AIW plan/status/review machinery or wait for an AIW reviewer. AIW is used only for mechanical functions with independent value: the required short hardware lock, canonical final Chinese operator-prompt, release gate, and the minimum existing collaboration claim/evidence record needed to avoid collisions. AIW output can never replace code, real runtime, physical, or machine evidence.
listener_platform_four_capability_machin.logging_platform_role: Logging is the common development and diagnostics substrate for Listener and future products, not a feature limited to Bluetooth, recording, OTA, or a fourth isolated screen. intermittent_slow_delivery_root_cause.diagnosis: The session received its first PCM 146 ms after Type started BLE recording, but packet 50 arrived 3.6 seconds later and the first meaningful ASR partial appeared about 5.18 seconds later. Firmware telemetry shows 1075 audio packets over 81.2 seconds at 6,352 bytes/s and 13 packets/s while the link remained interval 120 (150 ms), latency 9. The prior active-intent retry candidate did not fix this: NimBLE returned BLE_HS_EALREADY (2, an update already in progress), then BLE_GAP_EVENT_CONN_UPDATE status 554 (BLE_ERR_DIFF_TRANS_COLL, different transaction collision), and the promotion timed out while the low-power link remained active. This is firmware-to-Windows BLE delivery, not Volcengine, network, preview, or final-text processing.
intermittent_slow_delivery_root_cause.repair_contract: e11r=1 is the explicit Type-controlled fast-recording arm, not merely a post-press fast-path permission. While it is armed, CONNECTED_IDLE may still save board/audio power but must retain or promote the BLE connection to active parameters before any EC11 physical press; it must not issue the 80-120 interval / latency-9 low-power link request. A NimBLE BLE_HS_EALREADY result means the stack owns an existing connection-parameter transaction, so firmware must await BLE_GAP_EVENT_CONN_UPDATE rather than clear a shorter local timer or retry into the transaction. e11r=0 may return an already-idle connection to low-power parameters. The repair must retain the raw EC11 <=50 ms control dispatch, 500 ms single/double boundary, double-click cancellation, long-press cancellation, real PCM, and no preview/final masking.

acceptance_targets: Accuracy evidence must compare the retained audio sample or fixture input with the transcript/history output for the active dictation path.

Every dictation validation must record the active ASR engine identity; if the session is not using the core Volcengine accurate engine, Type must make the accuracy risk visible instead of letting a lower-accuracy provider look like a Listener regression.

Every failed dictation validation must classify whether the primary cause is external provider/network/credential availability or an internal recording, BLE transport, insertion, or preview pipeline issue.

Capsule preview quality is part of the recording contract: the preview is a stabilized partial transcript, the final transcript is authoritative, and release evidence must measure preview-to-final consistency across the visible preview stream, not only the final text.

stricter_metric_revision.source: Product-owner steering during Listener 1.0.2 preproduction recording-chain acceptance: recording is the core competitive capability, sensitivity must remain consistently high, preview must match the accurate transcript path, and regressions must identify whether the cause is external provider/network or internal pipeline.
requirements: Tighten the recording metric instead of accepting one good sample: accuracy, wake/first-preview speed, completion speed, low-volume sensitivity, preview smoothness, and no-regression stability must be validated together.

Product owner directed that the next acceptance evidence must prioritize real human speech on the installed Listener path. Synthetic corpus evidence remains diagnostic only and must not delay or replace a user-ready physical recording/preview observation.

For every focused real-speech review, show one randomly selected literal sentence inside the canonical operator popup itself before the operator acts; chat may duplicate it, but cannot replace the popup text. The popup must visibly delimit the exact words to speak and say that no surrounding operating instruction is to be spoken. The popup records the result and any observation and must not make the operator search for the test text.

After each spoken-popup attempt, capture and classify the matching real session logs before offering the next popup: report the actual ASR provider, packet integrity, preview timing and progression, completion timing, transcript match, and whether any fault is internal, external provider credentials, or network. Repair a classified product failure before continuing the acceptance sequence.

Capsule preview is a first-class recording quality requirement: on real speech it must appear promptly, progress coherently, and agree with the final transcript. For every mismatch, retain per-session evidence that identifies the realtime preview result, final-transcript result, and final selection decision; do not mask the issue with cosmetic animation changes or a phrase-specific replacement.

A fixed short sentence is only a reproducible regression anchor, never sufficient release evidence. Final recording acceptance must use a seeded, retained randomized corpus spanning distinct topics, sentence lengths, phrasing, numbers, proper nouns, pauses, and normal/low-volume conditions so a fix cannot pass one phrase while regressing ordinary dictation. A small family of product-term rewrites is not randomized evidence and must not be used for the human popup loop.

For the capsule-preview human acceptance loop, use a randomly selected long natural sample with an expected spoken duration of at least about fifteen seconds. Short samples remain useful only for first-preview responsiveness and cannot by themselves accept preview smoothness, duplication, truncation, or convergence.

A validation run is invalid rather than PASS or product FAIL when a real device capture or another active recording session overlaps its replay session; the evidence must name the collision and rerun the affected randomized sample after the bench is isolated.
Record the ASR provider used by each dictation session and warn when the active provider is not the core accurate Volcengine path.
Record provider/network/credential attribution separately from internal BLE, recorder, insertion, or preview failures so a bad external service does not get misdiagnosed as a product regression.

Embedded microphone conditioning must use a session-level, voice-gated adaptive gain controller rather than independently maximizing every transport PCM block. It must retain peak headroom, avoid changing its control state on quiet chunks, and record voiced/quiet chunk counts, first/final/max gain, gain-update count, and clipped samples for every real-device attempt so sensitivity instability is attributable and reproducible.

Make the capsule preview use the same authoritative recognition path for correction: low-latency partial text may appear early, but final-stream supplemental text must be able to repair the preview before Done.

Add a preview anti-regression metric based on the mainstream streaming-ASR partial/final model: partial preview may revise while unstable, but stable visible preview updates must converge toward the final transcript.
proposed_quantitative_targets: Before human acceptance, retain one isolated installed Program Files physical preflight using one randomly selected long-text sample. It must have missing_packets=0 and retained-fixture transcript accuracy=1.0; there is no 12-session, normal-versus-low-volume, or group-spread batch quota.

The one machine preflight must retain its randomized-corpus manifest entry, expected transcript, source/transform identity, session id, accuracy, packet-loss result, engine identity, attribution, preview/final consistency, and timing result.

The one machine preflight must have first visible preview <=5000 ms after its first real PCM, max visible preview gap <=1500 ms, and stop-received-to-Done <=800 ms. Human sensitivity is judged in the final focused review from detected speech onset to first visible preview; no separate low-volume machine batch is required.

For the retained preflight fixture with speech starting at frame zero, first real audio PCM to first visible preview must be <=5000 ms. For real human speech, record raw PCM-to-preview separately from detected speech-onset-to-preview so user deliberation before speaking is not misclassified as a sensitivity failure.
Last stable recording preview must have preview/final CER <=0.10 and final-text coverage >=0.90 for every retained fixture run.

For every visible preview update after at least 4 normalized characters, at least 90% of updates must remain compatible with the final transcript by either preview-content support coverage >=0.90 or partial CER <=0.30; any consecutive divergent-preview window must stay <=1200 ms.
Every smoke report must include asr_engine.core_accurate=true for release acceptance, or a user-visible non-core-engine accuracy warning plus an intentional test label.

Every smoke report must include issue_attribution.primary; PASS release runs require primary=none, while FAIL runs must classify external_provider_credentials, external_provider_network, external_provider_unavailable, internal_ble_transport, internal_recording_pipeline, internal_insertion_pipeline, or internal_preview_pipeline.

Cold boot PWR must show the same capped warm amber color and brightness as the shutdown-confirm PWR cue without an all-black first latch; startup time is measured from boot PWR lighting to stable BLE-visible readiness, so boot amber must remain until BLE is truly visibly ready and no startup-complete/PWR-normal cue may be shown early to fake a faster boot. During this focused PWR/EC11 confirmation, a straight EC11 push must not be decoded as a rotation, and the existing EC11 pending-shutdown fill effect must not intermittently black out and then restore during the long press.

scenarios.bench_title: Type LED brightness and low-power exact sync
scenarios.product_contract: Type defaults status/key LED brightness to 50/80, writes each LED zone brightness as firmware caps, allows brightness number fields to be cleared and retyped without a leading-zero value such as 050, and preserves every low-power minute value exactly without hidden dimming or readback rounding.
Writing the current BLE name again must be a normal settings write only: no DEVICE:SET ble_name, no BLE-name apply, no Windows cache refresh, no PairAsync, and no pairing prompt.

scenarios.bench_title: Random BLE name exact cache refresh
scenarios.product_contract: Writing a different valid BLE name must update firmware, clear this PC's stale pairing/cache through the same Type-controlled recovery path, show the same BLE blue double-flash/reconnect recovery cue as Type-controlled double-click repair, reconnect without opening this PC's Windows Bluetooth Settings/user pairing prompt, leave Windows/Type displaying the exact new fully random ASCII name with no listener/LT/type family prefix, and use silent rename recovery so other computers do not receive a Swift Pair prompt during rename. Explicit cross-computer re-pair remains the double-click/native Windows pairing flow. Same-name writes remain no-repair/no-prompt.

Restoring the default BLE name listener is a different-name rename when the current name is not listener, so it must run the same Type-controlled cache refresh/reconnect path, show the same BLE blue double-flash/reconnect recovery cue, avoid opening this PC's Windows Bluetooth Settings/user pairing prompt, suppress Swift Pair prompts on other computers during rename, then prove exact display-name confirmation.

scenarios.bench_title: Manual Windows delete must not autopair with Type

scenarios.product_contract: With Listener Type fully exited and no listener-type.exe process, Windows native Add device > Bluetooth must pair listener without Type PairAsync, leave BTHLE listener OK, configure/start HID service 00001812, and expose a keyboard.inf/kbdhid Col01 keyboard path instead of looping between connected and disconnected.

After no-Type native pairing, reopening the latest installed MSI Listener Type must take over the existing paired listener without PairAsync, Windows pairing prompt, forced repair, or device deletion. The process must be C:\Program Files\Listener Type\listener-type.exe, Windows Bluetooth must keep BTHLE listener OK, Type must start background BLE capture and reach background listener notify ready within 3 seconds on the persisted startup path, then device-key recording/control events must be delivered without requiring re-pair.

EC11 single click must remain a single-click action and must not open pairing recovery. A fast EC11 double click must cancel the first pending single click, avoid starting dictation, and enter the BLE recovery cue before the full Type automatic recovery scenario is judged.

scenarios.bench_title: EC11 double-click repair with Type automatic recovery
scenarios.product_contract: With Type present, double-click repair first clears this PC's stale Windows pairing cache, then waits for the fresh Listener recovery advertisement before running the bounded Type PairAsync recovery path automatically. If another computer completes Windows popup pairing first, this Type instance must stop waiting instead of looping or stealing the bond back.

scenarios.bench_title: Computer switch flow with and without Type
scenarios.product_contract: Without Type, the user must manually remove stale Windows pairing before native pairing. With Type on the target PC, Type may clear local stale pairing first, then wait for the fresh Listener recovery advertisement and run bounded automatic PairAsync recovery; if another host pairs first, the old Type instance must stop instead of looping or stealing the bond back.

When any device custom key is configured as Dictation, the first valid press after connected/disconnected low-power idle wake must not be swallowed: firmware records wake activity, continues the ordinary debounce path instead of synthesizing a false click, sends the F13-F24 fallback HID event for the configured key/gesture, Type maps that device key action to Dictation, and the capsule/audio/LED recording path begins normally. The same focused acceptance must prove the full recording chain is production-ready: transcript accuracy is checked against retained audio or fixture input, wake-to-recording and submit-to-preview/Done timings stay within the accepted recording_low_latency baseline, and the root-cause regression guard is run so future fixes cannot silently degrade the path again.

OTA pre-upgrade is machine-only: the installed Program Files Type identity, current staged package manifest/hash, and OTA GATT capability must be verified from repeatable logs without an operator prompt. A human review, if needed, is limited to the actual OTA transfer and post-upgrade user-visible return-to-ready behavior.

Denzic root may contain only ListenerType_1.0.2_x64_en-US.msi and ListenerFirmware_1.0.2_ota.zip. The root MSI hash must match the latest Type MSI source artifact, the root firmware OTA zip hash must match the latest stable firmware OTA source artifact, and no Type portable zip or older package may remain.
